steps.name: deploy-ready
steps.summary: scripts/deploy.sh (run with `sh`, gcloud run deploy --source with --region asia-northeast3, secret from Secret Manager, then curls /api/health); .dockerignore/.gcloudignore also drop phases, evals, evidence, e2e, test outputs and test configs; GET /api/health?deep=1 via src/lib/health.ts createDeepHealth (store get of a never-issued id must be null, models.get for text and live ids, 5 s timeout each, 60 s cache, 200/503, checks ok|fail); getStore refuses STORE=memory in production unless ALLOW_MEMORY_STORE=1; missing GEMINI_API_KEY already gives UPSTREAM (tests added); OPERATIONS.md Deploy section (flags, rollback, uptime check); ARCHITECTURE/SECURITY health rows updated; Docker build and deep health on Cloud Run unverified (I-086)
